name: Six science packs · all intermediates inside · 60/min each
setupNotes: Factorio 2.1.24. Simultaneous red, green, blue, military, purple and yellow science: target 60/min each. All intermediates, batteries and stone bricks built inside. AM2, electric furnaces, chemical plants, red belts and fast inserters. No modules, robots or inserter stack bonus. Feed all labeled solid/fluid ports from the left; collect science from right-side chests. Preserve the red circuit wires: local stock controls prevent circulation belts from filling. External electricity required.

optimization.scope: Deterministic partitioned production layout with direct green-circuit wire insertion; no global optimality claim.
